fullPassage: The film production industry extensively utilizes AI in various ways. This is because it not only assists producers in creating films more conveniently, but also enables them to make what they intended to express come alive with enhanced realism and naturalness. Recently, an AI-based program was developed, through which actors’ faces on the screen are aged or made younger. For example, when provided with the input of a thirty-five-year-old man’s face, the AI program generates different facial images at different ages. While there have been existing techniques that can achieve similar results, they required an extensive process. However, the newly developed automatic program accelerates the process. In order to develop this program, thousands of pictures of faces ranging from eighteen years old to eighty-five years old were accumulated as input to this program. It was then trained to learn how faces change as people age, and derived the principles for aging. With them, the program can manipulate the facial changes of actors with the addition or removal of wrinkles. As a result, it can produce output that is highly realistic. These results are maintained even when the actors make varied facial expressions. Due to the convenience and the naturalness of the results, it is expected that this technique will be widely incorporated in filmmaking.

det.analysis:
✅ ① utilizes: 'The film production industry extensively utilizes AI'에서 주어 industry가 단수이므로 3인칭 단수 동사 utilizes가 적절

✅ ③ developed: 'an AI-based program was developed'에서 주어 program이 개발되는 대상이므로 수동태 was developed의 과거분사 developed가 적절
✅ ④ provided: 'when provided with the input of a ... face'는 when 뒤 주어+be동사가 생략된 분사구문으로, 얼굴이 제공되는 수동 의미의 과거분사 provided가 적절
det.tip: 주어 it은 단수이므로 병렬되는 동사도 3인칭 단수 enables를 씁니다.

This is because it not only ②<u>assists</u> producers in creating films more conveniently, but also enables them ③<u>making</u> what they intended to express come alive with enhanced realism and naturalness.  Recently, an AI-based program was developed, through which actors’ faces on the screen are aged or made younger. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① utilizes: 'The film production industry extensively utilizes AI'에서 단수 주어 industry에 맞는 3인칭 단수 utilizes가 적절
✅ ② assists: 'it not only assists producers in creating films'에서 단수 주어 it에 맞는 assists가 적절
❌ ③ making → to make: 동사 enable은 'enable + 목적어 + to부정사' 형태를 취하므로 'enables them to make'가 되어야 한다. making은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ provided: 'when provided with the input of a ... face'는 주어+be동사가 생략된 분사구문의 과거분사 provided가 적절
det.tip: enable은 목적격보어로 to부정사(to make)를 취합니다.

questions.stem:

『우리말』 그 결과, 그것은 매우 사실적인 결과물을 만들어 낼 수 있다.

(1) highly, is, output, produce, realistic, that을 모두 사용할 것

det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- can(조동사) + produce(동사원형): '만들어 낼 수 있다'
- output that is highly realistic: 선행사 output을 주격 관계대명사 that절이 수식하며 '매우 사실적인 결과물'을 나타낸다.
- that절의 동사 is + 부사 highly + 형용사 realistic로 '매우 사실적인'을 표현한다.
det.tip: 조동사 can 뒤 produce + [output that is highly realistic] 순서로 배열합니다.

questions.wa: produce output that is highly realistic
accept: produce output that is highly realistic
